name: iron-frontier-art-pipeline
description: Standalone Node CLI toolchain that generates, post-processes and atlas-packs Iron Frontier's art assets. Kept separate from frontend/package.json because these scripts run in Node (fs, sharp) rather than the browser, and pull in dependencies (sharp, an image-generation client) that the Vite app itself must never bundle.

scripts.art:all: npm run art:gen && npm run art:process && npm run art:pack
